Bahasa Inggris: On a bright afternoon, I decided to take a walk in the city park.
Terjemahan: Pada sore yang cerah, saya memutuskan untuk berjalan-jalan di taman kota.
Kalimat Cerita: On a bright afternoon, I decided to take a walk in the city park.

Bahasa Inggris: The air felt cool, and birds were chirping happily in the trees.
Terjemahan: Udara terasa sejuk, dan burung-burung berkicau riang di pepohonan.
Kalimat Cerita: The air felt cool, and birds were chirping happily in the trees.

Bahasa Inggris: In the middle of the park, I saw a child flying a kite with his father.
Terjemahan: Di tengah taman, saya melihat seorang anak bermain layang-layang bersama ayahnya.
Kalimat Cerita: In the middle of the park, I saw a child flying a kite with his father.

Bahasa Inggris: The kite was flying high, drifting freely in the blue sky.
Terjemahan: Layang-layang itu terbang tinggi, melayang bebas di langit biru.
Kalimat Cerita: The kite was flying high, drifting freely in the blue sky.

Bahasa Inggris: Not far from there, a group of people were sitting on a park bench, talking and enjoying ice cream.
Terjemahan: Tak jauh dari sana, sekelompok orang duduk di bangku taman, mengobrol dan menikmati es krim.
Kalimat Cerita: Not far from there, a group of people were sitting on a park bench, talking and enjoying ice cream.

Bahasa Inggris: The atmosphere felt peaceful and made me smile.
Terjemahan: Suasananya terasa damai dan membuat saya tersenyum.
Kalimat Cerita: The atmosphere felt peaceful and made me smile.
